verdict.rationale: GlitchTip is open source and documented as runnable on your own server, with first-party install docs covering Docker Compose and a Helm chart, minimal requirements (PostgreSQL plus optional Valkey/Redis), and automatic migrations on upgrade. Independent users confirm long-running, low-maintenance self-hosting with far fewer components than self-hosted Sentry, though some find deployment more involved than a single binary. Missing for 10: a single-binary or single-container deployment, since community reports describe some deployment friction from its multiple services.
